protocol.source_cache: Preserved C55-C58 balanced_v2 five-phase histories, targets and frozen strong trees.
protocol.direction_deviation: I5_N has C30/C33 three-phase caches only; use I5_S and I10_W two seasons to preserve truly separate five roles.
protocol.fit: Fit-only condition-separated empirical joint trajectories, Gaussian threshold/observation smoothing; legal thirteen-slot history has fixed 8-bin summaries.
protocol.checkpoint: Choose nearest-neighbor count from [8,24] by equal-condition/equal-window Brier, ties prefer24. No other event hyperparameter search.
protocol.decision: Freeze old incumbent/tree/thresholds from original decision seal; calibrate event old-decoder with exactly the original 31-threshold/condition/force grid. New decoder has zero tuned parameters.
protocol.selection: Primary event+new-decoder versus strong old+old, gain>=.02 and day-block CI lower>0. No retuning; seal before assessment.
protocol.assessment: Report every fixed four-way arm and both MC seeds, even failed arms. Main research gate requires overall gain>=.02, lower95CI>0, positive sign in all four direction-season cases and >=30 unique onset origins.
protocol.decoder: Same finite candidate rule/scenario budget for both information arms: empty, 5 thresholds,7 count prefixes,16 sampled trajectories; joint six-step average scenario IoU. Old p uses IID scenarios, event p uses shared fit template and temporally correlated observation noise.
protocol.information_control: Old p+new decoder retains exact old marginal p; event p+old decoder uses same old decision algorithm/calibration grid. Four-way experiment separates new conditional marginals and scenario decision effects, but does not separately identify every dependence assumption.
protocol.relationship_to_C79: Both use empirical joint scenarios. C79 fixed tree marginals and fit-only unconditional empirical dependence; this model predicts new marginals and trajectory weights from H,E. No claim of novel generic kNN or MC-IoU algorithm.
protocol.noise_assumption: sigma=clip(robust five-minute speed difference scale/sqrt(2),1.5,8)km/h; traffic innovations confound actual sensor noise. Shared Gaussian threshold noise correlation .5 fixed.
protocol.prediction_domain: Full public node x6 domain; onset first5 empty from announced condition. Future availability,quality,observations are training targets or evaluator-only, never prediction-set inputs.
protocol.sample_bias: Preserved proxy sampler selected future observed positives. Its population is not the unknown official latent selector; this bias is not solved.
protocol.date_provenance: All public calendars previously used for development; these are not blind tests.
protocol.uncertainty: 4000 paired calendar-day circular moving-block draws,7-day blocks; origins deduplicated across event sampler seeds. Same calendar draws shared across corridors; separate seasons sampled separately. MC seeds are not independent traffic events.
protocol.interpretation: Observed noisy Queue proxy only. Bottleneck denotes an observed trajectory location tag, not identified causal capacity drop; graph-incomplete direction/front summaries stay qualified. No latent true Queue labels available.
protocol.stop: Do not expand architecture or threshold/search grid if initial gate fails.
